page0.text:
Tohsaka is right.
Saber risked her life to draw Berserker away.
I need to escape from here and wait for Saber to return.

page1.text:
"Haah... Haah... Haah..."
I hurry across the bridge from Shinto and run home.
I never once look back.
Whether out of fear of a nonexistent pursuer or guilt over leaving Saber behind, I'm not sure.
Either way, I run for my life, my eyes fixed on the road ahead of me.

page2.text:
...
...The living room is just as I left it.
The air has remained still since Lancer's attack and Tohsaka coming over.
I go over to the repaired window.
I find two small pieces of glass on the floor. Tohsaka must have missed them.

page3.text:
"...There's no crack in the window... I wonder how she made up for the missing pieces."
I mutter to myself.
...For some reason, I don't feel like turning on the light.
I hide in the darkness as if to conceal my weakness.

page4.text:
"..."
What I should be thinking about...
What I should be saying... I'm running away from these things.
...The person who was here in this room until a few hours ago.
The person who was beside me until a few minutes ago.
I should be asking myself whether it was right to leave those two behind, but I can't seem to do anything but hide in this darkness.

page5.text:
The clock strikes 3 AM.
...It's been 30 minutes since then.
Whatever the outcome, the battle's probably over by now.

page6.text:
...
I should go back.
I pull myself together and look up to turn on the light...
Suddenly, a sharp pain sears the back of my left hand, then disappears.

page7.text:
"...The Command Spell is getting lighter...?"
The color has faded from the Command Spell.
The shape remains, but the bright red that proves I am Saber's Master has disappeared.
I know, instinctively, what that means.
"No, Saber...!"
I follow my instincts and run out of the darkness where I've been hiding.

page8.text:
I run outside.
I know I'm too late.
Even so, I run as fast as I can back to where I left Saber...
Something I can't see lashes from ahead and impales my heart.

page9.text:
"..."
...I can't hear too well.
There's something in front of me. Something's protruding from my chest. I just...can't make out what.

page10.text:
"...?"
The...something in front of me sneers and tells me I'm an idiot.
It's laughing at me and saying there's no reason for me to be alive after I lost my Servant.

page11.text:
"Oh..."
That's right...
Shirou Emiya dies the moment that he loses Saber.
Without Saber, I have no means of protecting myself. I can't possibly survive.

page12.text:
I'm all alone now. I hadn't realized it, but I am.
And this is where that's brought me.
This would have happened the same whether I was at home, or wherever I might have tried to run.

page13.text:
"Hrrk..."
My consciousness fades away...
I don't know who it is, and I don't care whether that thing piercing my heart is a spear or an arrow.
It doesn't matter whether I die here and now or tomorrow.
